records.note: No prison-housing placement data for trans prisoners in Russia was found. The mandated single enwiki full-text search returned no Russia-specific placement content; the top hit, Wikipedia's 'LGBTQ people in prison' (fetched, HTTP 200), covers Russia only for same-sex conjugal visits (in open settlements) and contains no housing-placement rule (birth-sex vs identity), no trans special units, and no solitary/segregation practice for trans prisoners. Russia's 2023 statutory ban on legal gender transition (base-lane sources) means identity cannot be reflected in identity documents, but no citable source documenting actual custody placement was located within the fetch budget; no usable finding.

adds.title: Even If You Go to the Skies, We'll Find You: LGBT People in Afghanistan After the Taliban Takeover (Human Rights Watch / OutRight Action International)
adds.summary: HRW/OutRight 43-page report (26 Jan 2022, 60 interviews) documents that since the Taliban takeover of 15 Aug 2021, LGBT Afghans have faced threats, assault, blackmail and wrongful-detention risk, with Taliban members using leaked personal data to pursue individuals considered gay or gender-nonconforming. Thin for the prison-housing axis: the report documents detention-related dangers for LGBT Afghans but contains no placement practice for trans prisoners - no birth-sex-vs-identity housing rule, no trans special units, and no solitary/segregation practice is described; it recommends the Taliban end discrimination and violence against LGBT people.

records.note: No Afghan prison-housing placement data for trans prisoners was found: the mandated enwiki search returned nothing Afghanistan-specific, and the one known-good target fetched (HRW/OutRight, 26 Jan 2022) documents abuse and wrongful-detention risks for LGBT Afghans but contains no trans-specific placement, special-unit, or solitary/segregation practice. Afghanistan's criminal framework penalises same-sex conduct and the 2024 Morality Law (base-lane sources) raises detention risk for trans people, but custody-housing specifics remain undocumented.
